ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-3,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 2-J in the area bound by:

      the alley next south of and parallel to West Fifth Avenue; South Christiana Avenue; West
      Gladys Avenue; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Christiana Avenue;

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         ____________________________
                                                         Jason C. Ervin
                                                         Alderman, 28th Ward




Common Address:
318 South Christiana Avenue
